sources.name: Environment Agency Thames Estuary 2100
sources.fact: 23 policy units; long-term adaptation framework for sea-level rise and ageing defences

sources.name: EA Barking and Dagenham TE2100 policy unit
sources.fact: policy unit runs from Barking Creek Barrier to Beam River; south-east and south-west areas show 0.1% or higher annual flood chance without existing defences

sources.name: LBBD Local flood risk management strategy
sources.fact: LBBD is lead local flood authority; SFRA informs Local Plan, planning decisions and development design

sources.name: Planning Data flood-risk-zone
sources.fact: 780636 zones; authoritative origin; collector snapshot 2023-11-01; guide to probability, not certainty or severity

sources.name: Planning Data conservation-area
sources.fact: 11007 areas; 158 providers; collector 2026-07-24; work in progress, incomplete and duplicate coverage

sources.name: Planning Data listed-building
sources.fact: 382254 listed-building points; collector 2026-07-24; point does not define affected extent

sources.name: Planning Data listed-building-outline
sources.fact: 124897 outlines; 96 providers; collector 2026-07-24; indicative only; incomplete coverage and curtilage caveat

sources.name: Planning Data green-belt
sources.fact: 190 areas; annual-return snapshot; collector 2026-07-23; new data 2026-05-10; snapshot lag caveat

sources.name: Planning Data article-4-direction-area
sources.fact: 7152 areas; 111 providers; collector 2026-07-24; partial developing coverage

sources.name: Planning Data tree-preservation-zone
sources.fact: 94023 zones; 79 providers; collector and new data 2026-07-26; small-group/developing specification caveat

sources.name: Planning Data special-area-of-conservation
sources.fact: 260 SACs; collector 2026-07-26; Natural England/DEFRA protected-site context

sources.name: LBBD Regulation 19 evidence base
sources.fact: evidence base includes IDP, HRA, green infrastructure, transport, housing supply and viability evidence

examples: TE2100 is adaptation/flood-management context, not parcel flood prediction
Barking and Dagenham policy unit requires defence context before interpreting raw flood probability
Planning Data flood-risk-zone snapshot age must be disclosed
Conservation-area negative result cannot be treated as proof because dataset is incomplete/duplicated
Listed-building point is not affected extent
Listed-building outline is indicative and does not consistently show curtilage
Green-belt data is an annual snapshot and may lag boundary changes
Article 4 and tree-preservation datasets require provider-coverage checks before negative conclusions
